jobs.occupation: Customer Service Coordinator - German + Dutch or French
jobs.description:
Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, French, Dutch and German

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager - Supply Chain & Logistics - Belgium
jobs.description:
Our client is a market-leading European provider of logistics, transportation, and supply chain solutions, serving major international brands across the consumer goods and retail sectors. With a strong presence in Belgium and an extensive European network, the company operates in a fast-paced and operationally complex environment where service quality, customer partnership, and continuous improvement are key drivers of success.With a strong footprint in Belgium and a broader European presence, the organisation is currently going through an important phase of growth. This creates a stimulating environment where commercial teams work closely with operational stakeholders to deliver long-term value for customers and drive continuous improvement across the business.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of major international accounts. Your primary focus will be to strengthen long-term client partnerships, ensure customer satisfaction, and identify opportunities for sustainable business growth.Key responsibilities include:

• Acting as the main point of contact for strategic customers across Belgium and Europe.
• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders within client organisations.
• Proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
• Leading contract renewals, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, and volume agreements.
• Managing customer escalations and coordinating effective solutions with internal stakeholders.
• Working closely with operational teams to ensure service excellence and continuous improvement.
• Monitoring account performance, profitability, and commercial KPIs.
• Coordinating with multiple internal departments and business sites across Belgium.
• Contributing to business development initiatives within existing accounts and identifying selected growth opportunities.
• Frequent travel across Belgium, with occasional travel within Europe.

• At least 5 years of experience in a strategic B2B Key Account Management position.
• Proven experience managing large and complex customer accounts.
• Strong negotiation skills with exposure to senior decision-makers.
• Solid understanding of logistics, transportation, supply chain, or another operationally B2B environment.
• Ability to navigate complex organisations and manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
• Highly autonomous, proactive, and capable of taking ownership.
• Strong commercial mindset combined with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Solution-oriented with the resilience to manage challenging situations and customer escalations.
• Analytical, structured, and eager to learn.
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Willingness to travel regularly across Belgium and occasionally within Europe.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Your role:

You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.

• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed.

• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills.

• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement.
